crossRefs.note: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.
“I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.
who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ, our Lord.
May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at…
He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.
in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;
to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,
who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.
Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my…
He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
Yahweh is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.
Yahweh, within her, is righteous. He will do no wrong. Every morning he brings his justice to light. He doesn’t fail…
What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!
Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,
and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels…

translations.web: to show that Yahweh is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
translations.bsb: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”
translations.kjv: To shew that the LORD is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness
translations.asv: To show that Jehovah is upright; He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.
